_comment: Earnings calendar for scripts/watch.py. Timing only — never theses.
print_at is a SCHEDULING HINT (when polling starts), deliberately
early-biased; it never decides which filing counts. Filing identity =
baseline_accession (newest qualifying accession at arm time) +
expected_report_date (the fiscal period this event is for).
thesis_entry/thesis_sha256 are written by `watch.py link` and pin the
one journal entry allowed to authorize this event's report.
